verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a built-in voice library plus custom voice cloning (bland-docs-10, bland-docs-33), satisfying the 'broad voice library' part of the story, but there is no evidence of support for plugging in external third-party TTS providers. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-provider TTS integration (e.g., ElevenLabs, PlayHT, or similar) and any provider-agnostic voice configuration.
